data.request: Agente B: catálogo. Dominio: ingredients (parser que respeta paréntesis), text_search (sin tildes ni ñ), image_url (buckets de Unsplash) y dish_filter freezed. Providers: filtro, búsqueda y orden, visibleDishes, featuredDishes y dishDetail(id) (muestra al instante lo que ya está en la lista y luego llama a GET /api/dish/{id}). Tests: parser, búsqueda, filtros y orden, image_url, providers.

data.cmd: fvm flutter analyze && fvm flutter test test/features/dishes/domain

data.summary: parseIngredients splits on commas outside parentheses (nested depth, trims, drops empties and a final period); foldForSearch/matchesSearch ignore case, accents, ñ and combining marks, all words required; sizedImageUrl buckets Unsplash widths 400–1600 with q=75, auto=format.

data.cmd: fvm dart run build_runner build -d && fvm flutter analyze && fvm flutter test test/features/dishes

data.summary: Freezed DishFilter (query, category, sort) whose apply() keeps category and search matches and sorts A–Z, best rated, price up/down or most protein with the folded name breaking ties; DishCategory thresholds 35 g; twelve sample dishes for tests.

data.cmd: fvm dart run slang && fvm dart run build_runner build -d && fvm flutter analyze && fvm flutter test

data.summary: CatalogFilter notifier (search, clear, category, sort); visibleDishes and featuredDishes map the list's AsyncValue synchronously; dishDetail(id) streams the listed copy, then the server's, ending in notFound on a 404.
